A train covers a distance of 225 km in 2(1)/(2) hours at a uniform speed. The time taken by the train (in hours) to cover a distance of 630 km at the same speed is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time is taken by train to cover 225 km = 2(1)/(2) hours

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Time is taken by train to cover 225 km = 2(1)/(2) hours = 5/2 hours

Speed of the train = 225 ÷ (5/2) = 90 km/h

Time required to cover 630 km = 630/90 = 7 hours

**∴ The time is taken by the train (in hours) to cover a distance of 630 km at the same speed is 7 hours**

questions.question: Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P. If AB = 7 cm, CD = 1 cm and PD = 5 cm, then the length of PB (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Chords AB and CD of a circle intersect externally at P.

AB = 7 cm, CD = 1 cm and PD = 5 cm

**Concept used:**

If two chords of a circle intersect externally, then the product of the lengths of the segments are equal

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6cf10f0472eea3bfe063d8c2431b0f5893bac6c378bf5c5013a3d3f32c10c0c.png] 

Let, PB = x cm

PB × PA = PD × PC

⇒ x (x + 7) = 5 (5 + 1)

⇒ x² + 7x = 30

⇒ x2 + 7x - 30 = 0

⇒ x2 + 10x - 3x - 30 = 0

⇒ x (x + 10) - 3 (x + 10) = 0

⇒ (x + 10) (x - 3) = 0

⇒ x + 10 = 0 ⇒ x = - 10 [Not possible]

⇒ x - 3 = 0 ⇒ x = 3

**∴ The length of PB (in cm) is 3 cm**

questions.question: P and Q start a shop with a capital of Rs. 1,50,000 and Rs. 4,50,000, respectively. After a year, out of the profit of Rs. 1,60,000, P gets his share of profit plus some money that is not a part of the profit, as his salary. If P gets a total of Rs.70,000, what is the salary (in Rs.) he received?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P invested = Rs. 150000

Q invested = Rs. 450000

Total profit = Rs. 160000

**Calculation:**

P's share : Q's share = 150000 : 450000 = 1 : 3

P get from the profit = (1/4) × 160000 = Rs. 40000

P gets total amount = Rs. 70000

Total salary of P = 70000 - 40000 = Rs. 30000

**∴ The salary (in Rs.) P received is Rs. 30000**

questions.question: In ΔABC, AB = 7 cm, BC = 10 cm, and AC = 8 cm. If AD is the angle bisector of ∠BAC, where D is a point on BC, then DC (in cm) = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ΔABC, AB = 7 cm, BC = 10 cm, and AC = 8 cm

**Concept used:**

An angle bisector of an angle of a triangle divides the opposite side into two segments that are proportional to the other two sides of the triangle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10704cbfb9480f276e7970e5208cc0cddfecb557ca49c40f2a0aa83aa30121eb.png] 

AD is the angle bisector of ∠BAC

So, AB/AC = BD/DC

⇒ 7/8 = BD/DC

⇒ 8BD = 7DC

⇒ BD = 7DC/8 .....(1)

Here, BD + DC = BC

⇒ 7DC/8 + DC = BC = 10 [∵ BD = 7DC/8]

⇒ 15DC/8 = 10

⇒ DC = 10 × (8/15) = 80/15 = 16/3

**∴ The value of DC (in cm) is 16/3**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks an article at a price 20% higher than its cost price and allows 10% discount. Find his gain percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 20% higher than the cost price

Discount = 10%

**Formula used:**

S.P. = [(100 - Discount%)/100] × C.P.

Gain% = [(S.P. - C.P.)/C.P.] × 100

Where, C.P. = Cost price; S.P. = Selling price

**Calculation:**

Let, the cost price = Rs. 100

So, the marked price = 100 + (20% of 100) = Rs. 120

Then, the selling price = 120 × (90/100) = 108

Gain percentage = [(108 - 100)/100] × 100 = 8%

**∴ The gain percentage is 8%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

A shopkeeper allows a discount of m% on a article and mp of the article is r% more than the cp then

Profit%=[(r times (100-m))/(100)-m]

here r = 20,m = 10

⇒ [(20 times (100-10))/(100)-10]

⇒ 8%

∴ The gain percentage is 8%

questions.question: If 8A5146B is divisible by 88, then what is the value of AB ?
questions.solution:
Given:

The given number = 8A5146B

Concept used:

Divisibility rule of 8: If the last three digits of a number is divisible by 8, the number will be divisible by 8

Divisibility rule of 11: The provided integer is divisible if the difference between the sum of the digits at odd places and the sum of the digits at even places is 0 or divisible by 11.

Calculation:

8A5146B is divisible by 88

So, 8A5146B is divisible by 8 and 11

⇒ 46B should be divisible by 8

Put B = 4, 464 is divisible by 8

Hence, B = 4

Now, 8A51464 should be divisible by 11

⇒ (8 + 5 + 4 + 4) - (A + 1 + 6) should be divisible by 11

⇒ 21 - (A + 7) should be divisible by 11

⇒ 14 - A should be divisible by 11

Put A = 3 then, 14 - 3 = 11 which is divisible by 11

So, A = 3

∴ AB = 3 × 4 = 12

**∴ The value of AB is 12**

questions.question: In ΔABC, D is a point on side BC such that ∠ADC = ∠BAC. If CA = 15 cm and CD = 9 cm, then CB (in cm) = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠ADC = ∠BAC

CA = 15 cm and CD = 9 cm

**Concept used:**

If Two triangles are similar then, their corresponding angles are equal and their corresponding sides are within the same ratio (or proportion)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de9d27eaf0a87b205467223b0dd04fffe9e5553a79be9d99ac915c522e304003.png] 

In ΔCAB and ΔCDA,

∠BAC = ∠ADC (Given)

∠ACB = ∠ACD (Common)

So, ΔCAB ∼ ΔCDA (by AA similarity)

Then, CA/CB = CD/CA

⇒ 15/CB = 9/15

⇒ CB = (15 × 15)/9 = 25

**∴ The value of CB (in cm) is 25 cm**

questions.question: If x + y + z = 18, xyz = 81 and xy + yz + zx = 90, then find the value of sqrt[4]{x³+y³+z³+xyz} .
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 18, xyz = 81 and xy + yz + zx = 90

**Formula used:**

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z) [(x + y + z)2 - 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

**Calculation:**

x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz = (x + y + z) [(x + y + z)² - 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 - (3 × 81) = 18 [18² - (3 × 90)]

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 - 243 = 18 (324 - 270)

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 - 243 = 18 × 54

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 = 972 + 243 = 1215

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + xyz = 1215 + 81 = 1296

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + xyz = 6⁴

⇒ sqrt[4]{x³+y³+z³+xyz} = 6

**∴ The value of sqrt[4]{x³+y³+z³+xyz} is 6**

questions.question: A tyre has 3 punctures. The first puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 9 minutes, the second alone would have done it in 18 minutes, the third alone would have done it in 6 minutes. If the air leaks out at a constant rate, then how long (in minutes) does it take for all the punctures together to make it flat?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5608e79f1a8c0659c3b14fd896b4187ec3035c2d47b1663953b53565b8a45ad4.png] 

Total efficiency = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6

The time required = 18/6 = 3 minutes

∴ All punctures can make the tyre flat in 3 minutes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The first puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 9 minutes

The second puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 18 minutes

The third puncture alone would have made the tyre flat in 6 minutes

**Calculation:**

In 1 minute, the first puncture can make (1/9)th of the tyre flat

In 1 minute, the second puncture can make (1/18)th of the tyre flat

In 1 minute, the third puncture can make (1/6)th of the tyre flat

In 1 minute, the all tyres can make (1/9) + (1/18) + (1/6) = (1/3)th of the tyre flat

Total required time to flat = 3 minutes

**∴ All punctures can make the tyre flat in 3 minutes**

questions.question: A man bought toffees at 3 for a rupee. How many toffees for a rupee must he sell to gain 50%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man bought toffees at 3 for a rupee

**Formula used:**

S.P. = [(100 + Profit%)/100] × C.P.

Where, C.P. = Cost price; S.P. = Selling price

**Calculation:**

The cost price of 1 toffee = Rs. 1/3

The required selling price of 1 toffee = (1/3) × (150/100) = Rs. 1/2

At the price of Rs. 1/2 we get 1 toffee, then at the price of Rs. 1 we can get (1)/(frac{1){2}} = 2 toffee

**∴ The total 2 toffees for a rupee must be sold to gain 50%**

questions.question: The expression (cos⁶ θ + sin⁶ θ – 1)(tan² θ + cot² θ + 2) + 3 is equal to:
